answer: Total Revenue 16,008,872.12 | Latest Revenue 589.67 | Total Rolling Avg 3M 16,017,057.77 | Latest Rolling Avg 3M 342,484.84
sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) as month,
        SUM(p.payment_value) as revenue
    FROM ds_olist_orders o
    JOIN ds_olist_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    month,
    revenue,
    AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_3m
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;
question: Show monthly revenue with a 3-month rolling average

answer: Avg Delivery Days 507.06 | Latest Avg Delivery Days 8.76
sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_state AS state,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM ds_olist_orders o
JOIN ds_olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL 
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC

answer: Avg Customer Lifetime Value 5,361.71 | Latest Avg Customer Lifetime Value 142.48
sql:
WITH customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_state, SUM(p.payment_value) AS ltv
    FROM ds_olist_orders o
    JOIN ds_olist_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN ds_olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_state
)
SELECT customer_state, AVG(ltv) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM customer_ltv
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY avg_customer_lifetime_value DESC;

sql: WITH customer_years AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_state, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ds_olist_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS ordered_2017, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ds_olist_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) AS ordered_2018 FROM ds_olist_customers c), state_stats AS (SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_2017) AS customers_2017, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_2017 AND ordered_2018) AS customers_both FROM customer_years GROUP BY customer_state) SELECT customer_state, customers_2017, customers_both, ROUND(100.0 * customers_both / NULLIF(customers_2017,0), 2) AS retention_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(100.0 * customers_both / NULLIF(customers_2017,0), 2) DESC) AS retention_rank FROM state_stats WHERE customers_2017 > 0 ORDER BY retention_rate DESC, customer_state;
